title: Efficacy and safety of tranexamic acid in bimaxillary orthognathic surgery: systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
html: Bimaxillary orthognathic surgery often involves significant blood loss, requiring haemostatic control, which may include pharmacological interventions. Tranexamic acid (TXA) is widely used for this purpose; however uncertainty remains regarding its safety and optimal dosage. This systematic review and network meta-analysis was performed to evaluate the efficacy of intravenous TXA in reducing blood loss and transfusion need, and its safety in terms of thromboembolic risk. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing intravenous TXA at various doses and with placebo in bimaxillary procedures with quantitative outcomes were included.
